{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq
df_sorted = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 2: Compute response rate per site on the full deduplicated population
# No filtering on biomarker_baseline — per contract, include all enrolled patients after deduplication
response_rates = df_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(4)

# Step 3: Identify the site with the highest response rate
highest_site = response_rates.idxmax()
highest_rate = response_rates.max()

# Print final results
print("Response rates by site (full deduplicated population):")
print(response_rates)
print(f"\nSite with highest response rate: {highest_site}")
print(f"Highest response rate: {highest_rate}")

# Return values for submission
response_rates, highest_site, highest_rate"}
